title: CHORDS (scale-aware chords)
author: stephen
description: Scale-aware chords for the Digitone mk1 and Digitone Keys: hold a synth track's key, pick CHORDS in the Mod Menu, then a chord type (TRIAD, SUS2, SUS4, 6TH, 7TH, 9TH, ADD9) and a voicing (CLOSE, INV 1-3, OPEN). Each single-note trig on that track then plays that chord in the track's keyboard ROOT and SCALE; trigs that already hold a chord play as stored. Settings are per track and last until power-off. Needs core-dn1 3.1 and seq-events.
